D5/S1/Recurrence/PellCompanionGcd.P.name: D5.S1.Recurrence.PellCompanionGcd.P
D5/S1/Recurrence/PellCompanionGcd.P.signature: def P : Nat -> Nat | 0 => 0 | 1 => 1 | n + 2 => 2 * P (n + 1) + P n /-- Companion Pell numbers, with both initial values equal to one. -/ def Q : Nat -> Nat | 0 => 1 | 1 => 1 | n + 2 => 2 * Q (n + 1) + Q n /-- The two second-order sequences satisfy a coupled first-order recurrence. -/ theorem pell_companion_step (n : Nat) : P (n + 1) = P n + Q n ∧ Q (n + 1) = 2 * P n + Q n
